statement: ICE Brent front-month crude futures settle at or below 70.00 USD per barrel on at least one settlement date between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: Any ICE-published front-month Brent settlement price with a settlement date between 2026-08-06 and 2026-10-30 is 70.00 or lower.
failure_condition: Every ICE front-month Brent settlement inside the window prints above 70.00 USD per barrel.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A filing entered on the US Court of International Trade docket between 2026-08-06 and 2026-12-15 states that cumulative IEEPA tariff refunds issued have reached 150 billion USD or more.
resolution: A government filing on the CIT docket dated inside the window states cumulative IEEPA refunds of at least 150 billion USD. A lower stated figure resolves false.
failure_condition: Cumulative IEEPA refunds as stated in CIT filings remain below 150 billion USD through 2026-12-15.
